It was released in Japan on April 26th, 2025 for 1600円 as one of two prize Beyblades in [[Random Booster Vol. 6]]. It later debuted in western countries as '''Reaper Rhino C 4-55D''' in a Custom Line Starter Pack released by [[Hasbro]] for USD$14.99 in the United States.
